html: Run-2 eval under frozen pre-registration: 0/25 primary (FAIL), commit-probe mass 0.00 with collapsed diversity → commit mode ABSENT from the VLA's sampled distribution; all selection-class levers support-dead. Decision: RECONSIDER RECIPE; contact-skill line funded (CONTACT_SKILL_SPEC_v1). Approach itself is transformed: EE reaches 2–3 cm vs run1b's 0.35 m standoff.

Commit-window env wrapper + RLPD learner + reverse-curriculum start bank (160 entries, 40 demos, rungs = press−{5,10,25,100}, 8 demos held out). AG re-establishment + settle validation at restore (probe-driven). Stage-0 smoke: 75% rolling success in 31 min (bar was 50% in 2 h). Early lessons banked: per-chunk fresh buffers reset progress (now persisted); resumed alpha freezes exploration on new scenes (now reset per chunk); press−10 rung added after a 0/20 cliff between −5 and −25.

Original per-step dwell shaping paid +0.1/step for parked contact — a failed episode out-earned success 30:1 (demo 210). Replaced with a bounded progress bonus (0.02 × ≤5 steps) before any buffer contamination.

30 chunks (one per scene, serial, warm-started from the previous non-quarantined checkpoint): 216/509 episodes (42%), 91,611 env steps, 21.0 h. 18 scenes nonzero (5 converged ≥60%), 12 scenes zero at every attempt; d30/d50 blocked entirely by AG-validity discards (start-bank problem, not a learning problem). Cross-scene transfer is real and instant where it fires: d100, d190, d260 all succeeded on episode 1 (6–11 steps) after warm-start from another scene's checkpoint.

Policy-visited start-state harvest: frozen Run-2 VLA rolled from stage-3 anchors, sim state snapshotted inside the 10 cm shell. 54 boundary states from 5 demos (d20:3, d80:22, d110:2, d300:20, d340:7). Notable: d190/d260/d420 — the skill's best scenes — yielded zero snapshots: the VLA never entered the shell there, so the runtime gate would rarely fire on those scenes at eval. Bank not yet used in training.

Stage-2 (press−25) pass in progress, same serial order: 19 chunks so far, 61/339 (18%), 84,275 env steps, 19.2 h. Cold set persists: d110/130/160/220/240 zero at both rungs. Failure signature is bimodal across the whole campaign: successes press in ~12 steps median; ∼93% of failures time out >15 cm away.

d270 — zero successes at stage 1 — warm-started from d170's stage-2 checkpoint: first success at EP 5 (7 steps), second at EP 6. Warm-starting converts at least some cold scenes; the cold-scene question is (partly) a bootstrap/curriculum question, not raw capability.

First-principles design review published (The Last Ten Centimeters). Census verified against actual BDDL goal predicates: grasp+place gates 94/100 tasks (61 pure), articulated-close 23, press/toggle 7, cook/freeze/transform 17 — the previously quoted 79/46/20/6 doesn't reproduce under any single predicate-set definition. Corrections to the working brief: the denoising-variance readout is a proposal, not built; no AdaLN gate-magnitude telemetry or flight recorder exists (nearest built artifact: point_liveness.py, never run on this box); no posture-cluster AUC 0.77 analysis exists anywhere on this box. This logbook starts today; regenerate with python3 logbook/build_logbook.py.

Primitive-library plan adopted (design-review addendum): the VLA is a latent action bank either way — the upgrade is controlling the keys (affordance frame + L2 wrist geometry + contact classification, via AdaLN) and manufacturing the missing entries (flywheel from skill RL, FACT schedule, foveated inputs). Phase 1: prove keys on the 2M skill (L2-on arms, multi-scene single policy, grasp port to picking_up_trash). Phase 2: Run-3 distillation with a pre-registered validation ladder — commit-probe mass, NEW key-causality probe (±3 cm point perturbation at near-commit; a lookup ignores the key, a primitive tracks it), AdaLN liveness, denoising variance vs pre-retrain baseline, then arm-C on 301. Kill rule: probe mass still 0.00 ⇒ runtime skill + learned gate becomes the shipped architecture.

The warm-started d270 stage-2 chunk finished 8/23, rolling20 0.40 — the best stage-2 chunk of the entire pass, on a scene that was 0/10 fresh at stage 1. Checkpoint cleared the quarantine bar and is now the chain parent (d290 s2 live). Strongest cold-scene evidence yet that cold = starved prior, not incapable scene. Also quantified: the step-denominated chunk budget allocates episodes inversely to need (cold scenes got 10 episodes, healthy up to 50); trainer rebuild switches to episode budgets + seeding for cold scenes. Only 1 of 50 chunks ever hit the 0.95 early-stop (d260 s1, 43/50).

STAGE2_PASS_DONE — all 32 chunks run. Tail results: d290 21/25 (rolling20 0.80), the best stage-2 chunk of the campaign, continuing the d170→d270→d290 warm-start chain. The five predicted-cold chunks (d320/340/350/370/410) went 0/75 in ~5 h, exactly as forecast — the step-budget starvation flaw's final invoice. Box now idle; queued next: pre-retrain probe baselines (point_liveness, denoising-variance build, commit probe on current ckpt), throughput profile matrix, detector validation, gate-ROC, orientation analysis (radio yaw is fully randomized per scene — verified from instance files).

v1 recipe graded against its own pre-registered bars: the sim gate was never reached — 54 h bought rungs 1–2 of 4+ on 1 of 100 tasks, with success rate degrading outward (43% → 21%) and 13/32 scenes at zero. The learning works (RL is still the only commit-mode manufacturer; the d170→d270→d290 chain compounds); the harness fails (per-scene serial chunks, step budgets, blind obs, playback restores). SKILL_TRAINER_V2_SPEC.md written and bars frozen at first launch: one multi-scene policy, L2 un-blinded (yaw randomization verified makes blindness untenable), episode budgets + demo-replay seeding, snapshot restores, render-off, per-state frontier curriculum, flight recorder. Bars: B1 held-out ≥60% in ≤75k steps; B2 ≥6/11 cold scenes convert; B3 L2 beats blind by ≥15 pp; B4 ≥50% from boundary states. Kill rule reverts to flywheel-only from the 336 banked successes. Grasp port to picking_up_trash starts after V2 smoke, not after radio polish.

Throughput/restore matrix measured (d20, both render configs). D4 snapshot restores: GO — dump_state reload + AG re-establish takes 0.6–1.1 s and passes the 1 mm validity bar every time (dz 0.33 mm, AG 5/5), vs 34–71 s for the v1 playback+settle path (~45×). Render-off (D5): +19% stepping (0.435→0.365 s/step), −2 GB boot VRAM, halves restore cost; physics, not rendering, dominates stepping. New decomposition: profiler steps at 0.37–0.44 s/step with NO learner; v1 trained at 0.51–0.63 — the interleaved RLPD update round costs 0.1–0.2 s/step, so an async learner is worth 25–30%, more than render-off. Projected V2 economics: success episodes ~7 s (was ~60), failures ~112 s (was ~237); bar B1's 75k steps ≈ 8–12 h single-proc. Steady-state VRAM ~11 GB/proc — 2-proc test (22 GB on 24 GB card) running now.

point_liveness on radio_run2@49999: DEAD — the AdaLN affordance-point channel is ignored (n=64 labelled frames, pinned noise: conditioned-vs-not 0.70% relative action change, right-vs-wrong-point 0.53%). Confirms the Run-2 eval's n=5 'decorative' flag at mechanism level: the checkpoint of record is a pure visual-context policy — commit mass 0.00 and a dead key channel are two views of the same memorization bank. Consequences: Run-2's approach competence is data-driven, not point-driven; the terminal AdaLN source-switch is de-funded on this ckpt; serving-side point injection currently does nothing; and Run-3 must revive the key channel, not just add commit entries — which the skill's data is uniquely suited to, being point-supervised by construction (the skill servos on the affordance vector at states vision cannot disambiguate). Pre-registered post-retrain bar: rel |A−B| must exceed the 0.0053 baseline by a frozen margin. Baseline JSON: /root/point_liveness_run2_baseline.json.

P1 baseline banked with the byte-identical frozen instrument (demo 10, f1100, 25 fresh-connection chunks, server on the probe's native port 8000): commit_mass = 0.00 at 0.10/0.20/0.35 rad; trunk excursions flat (p50 −0.002 rad); diversity collapsed (cross-sample std 0.0025) — matches the 2026-08-11 measurement exactly. The pre-retrain triptych is now 2/3: P1 mass 0.00 ✓, P3 liveness DEAD ✓; the key-causality baseline (new instrument, ±3 cm point displacement at approach + near-commit bands, prediction: zero tracking at both) is running now against the live server.

The new key-causality probe (±3 cm affordance-point displacement, 10 chunks × 5 conditions × 2 bands, live server) returns IGNORES KEY at both the approach band (f700) and the near-commit band (f1100): every displacement-induced action delta sits BELOW the sampling-noise floor (SNR 0.3–0.66 vs a 3.0 bar) and the mirror-image directional signature is absent. Combined with liveness DEAD and commit mass 0.00, the pre-retrain triptych is complete and unanimous: the Run-2 checkpoint is a pure visual-context policy at every level — no commit entry, no connected key channel, no geometric tracking even where behavior is competent. Approach is 100% vision-driven, confirmed. Baselines frozen: point_liveness_run2_baseline.json, kc_probe_baseline.json, commit_probe_day0.log. Run-3's post-retrain bars now have exact zeros to beat. Policy server shut down; GPU freed for day-1 (V2 driver + snapshot bank + denoising-variance build).

Six parallel skeptic-verified dossiers via the new pwc CLI (Comet, VLA-Corrector, Qwen-RobotManip, 4D/WAM crop, RL-on-VLA, 30-query breadth sweep) → PWC_RESEARCH_2026_08_16.md. Headlines: our dead-channel disease is now a NAMED phenomenon with a published fix (BayesianVLA 'Information Collapse', ICML 2026, conditional-PMI objective, no new data); our flywheel is a validated blueprint (PLD, ICLR 2026, 61 cites); Comet measured 224²→720/480 resolution = 2× on turning_on_radio on our exact base model (and we already match all their other config cliffs — resolution + data are the live deltas vs their 100% radio); SRPO's offline arm proves reward-weighted distillation works from a 6.7%-base regime; no-WAM verdict strengthened by proponents' own ablations; SRPO-online and OGG discarded (support-dead). Corrections: DESIGN.md's Comet-448² note is wrong (real A/B is 720/480). Pre-Run-3 checklist added: probes at 20/32 denoise steps, LVM offline AUROC, action-expert-latent kill-test, resize-path verify, rules check on Comet's public RFT assets.

Snapshot bank complete: 150/160 entries validated and frozen (94%), all 40 scenes, 1 MB total. d30/d50 — v1's RESET_EXHAUSTED scenes — fully recovered under extended retries (bank-validity cold class: fixed). Newly documented: d230 (held-out) unrecoverable 0/4; d80/d290 (warm scenes) each lost 2 entries this pass — restore marginality is stochastic across runs, vindicating validate-once-freeze. Cold-scene orientation hypothesis REFUTED, informatively: using each scene's radio yaw + restored commit posture from the manifests, cold scenes overwhelmingly have the button FACING the robot (facing 0.9–1.0) while warm scenes contain all the reach-around cases (AUC 0.69 for coldness from clean face-on approaches, n=32). Leading interpretation: face-on postures alias across scenes in proprio space while requiring different fine motions — the blind-policy disease that L2 un-blinding (bar B3) tests directly.

The Qwen-RobotManip control (conditioning can be invisible at low denoise-step counts) is eliminated: liveness re-run at 20 steps (rel |A−B| 0.0050) and 32 steps (0.0050) matches the 10-step baseline (0.0053) — DEAD at every integration depth across a 3× range of denoising compute. The dead-channel diagnosis is airtight. Pre-Run-3 probe controls remaining: action-expert-latent kill-test, LVM offline AUROC. Day-2 next: V2 multi-scene driver on the fresh snapshot bank.

tag: V2 smoke: warm bar smashed, cold diagnosis sharpened
html: First V2 run (one shared policy, L2 on, snapshot resets, scenes d20+d80+d110): d20 23/23 (100%) and d80 19/20 (95%), both graduating at rolling ≥0.95 in round 1 — vs the same scenes' 44%/65% under v1, on a ≥50% smoke bar. 93 episodes / 15.8k env steps in 2.35 h; scene switches via snapshot load work (one boot serves all instances — a design simplification over the spec's process pool). One startup bug fixed en route (OG deserialize wants torch tensors; also revealed the serialized path carries AG params natively). d110 stayed 0/50 AND demo-replay seeding failed 4/4 — the human's own actions, replayed from the restored state, do not press the button. One confound found and fixed (seeding inherited ±3 cm DR jitter); the randomize-off diagnostic is running. If seeding still fails clean, d110's cold class = restore-state divergence (bank pathology), not policy incapability — which no observation upgrade can fix and redirects the cold-scene fix to the bank.

d110's cold class is physical, and the mechanism is now visible: with jitter off, the human's own demo actions still fail 4/4 — because the restored mid-carry state grips the radio at a synthetic contact point (finger-mean, not the human's true grip), so the held object sags 5–15 cm during replay and the button ends 8–12 cm from where the demo expects it. Two flaws exposed: (1) the spec's frozen-affordance-point contract is wrong for HELD objects — the target moves with the hand; fixed immediately (live target vector recomputed per step, DR as per-episode bias — also more eval-faithful); (2) AG re-establishment needs grip-pose fidelity at bank build (record the demo's true contact + in-hand pose) — queued. Full radio V2 run launched: all non-held-out scenes, all rungs, L2 on, live target, 25 eps/scene × 3 rounds — the first attempt at frozen bars B1/B2/B4 (~12–18 h).

Arif's decision: the eval-time backstop is removed. The 2M skill never runs at evaluation; the shipped system is the VLA alone, and on flywheel/probe failure the response is iterate (more harvest, next arm) — never a second controller. The serving gate is retired; its signals survive as diagnostics and curriculum inputs only. Geometry revival updated per the same discussion: the AdaLN geometry source switches from the coarse L0/L1 rows (redundant with pixels — likely why they died) to L2 wrist-frame features, non-redundant at contact by physics (the gripper occludes the cameras exactly when kinematics-built L2 still sees). Point revival (arm C) confirmed. Spec amended; architecture artifact rebuilt without the backstop lane.

V2 full run, round 0: 786 episodes, 212k env steps, 26 of 32 scenes with ≥1 success. Headline: d340 — fully cold across all of v1 — went 11/25 on first visit. True-cold scenes at the B2 threshold (≥3 succ): d160(5), d220(4), d340(11) = 3/11 so far, d130 at 1; B2 adjudicates on the full 3-round record. Bank-validity class demonstrated separately: d30 3, d50 2. Remaining hard core: d70/d110/d240 (diagnosed grip-infidelity; fix ready, applied at run end for single-variable discipline) + d320/350/370/410. B1 held-out eval scheduled post-run (no mid-flight sim contention). Round 1 — the transfer test — begins with d420's completion.

Round 0 complete: 800 episodes, 83 successes (10%), 26/32 scenes converted, all four rungs toured. Round 1 underway; d20's opening confirms the sampler skips mastered rungs and drills the wall (6× press−100 fails, 1/1 at press−10 — no forgetting). Key rung facts: press−100 = 0/301 with 38% of budget (gap too wide, sampler unordered); 19 of 38 press−100 states are PRE-PICKUP — the far rung already spans the combined grip+press problem. Per Arif's directive, V2.1 is formally scoped as GRIP + PRESS (spec §6): grip-fidelity restores, harvest states into rotation, radio grasp-initiation anchors (first pick_up_from source), press−50 bridge rung, rung-ordered sampling, combined-span episodes kept; pre-registered V2.1 bars: ≥10 held-out grasps in 50k steps, press−100 nonzero in ≥5 scenes, ≥2 of the grip-infidelity trio convert.

Decision: truncate round 1 at half (1,200 episodes) — the transfer sample is complete by then and V2.1 launches a day early. Watcher armed (clean SIGINT at threshold). V2.1 tooling built and compiled: new start bank generated (240 entries = 40 scenes × 6 anchors; press−50 rung + grasp-initiation anchors on ALL 40 demos — every human picked up; discovered: lift→press spans 200–350 frames, so grasp anchors naturally cover the full grasp→carry→press chain in one 300-step episode); snapshot builder gains --grip-fidelity (anchor AG at the demo-true state, measure relative-pose drift, retry ladder, all recorded); wrapper gains debounced lift-success + harvest-bank loader; driver gains rung-ORDERED frontier sampling (press rungs unlock in offset order; grasp/boundary are parallel tracks). Sequence: truncate tonight → V2.1 bank build overnight (~6–8 h) → V2.1 launch Wednesday morning.

tag: V2 run ended; V2.1 bank building
html: V2 full run ended at 1,036 episodes (round 0 complete + 10 round-1 revisit scenes; ~283k env steps; ~100 successes banked for the flywheel). Cut early per decision — the transfer analysis was already conclusive: retention solid (no forgetting across 32 scenes in one net), upward rung propagation fragile (press−25 pulsed to 19% then regressed to 2%), press−100 nil (0/345) — the exact pathologies V2.1's ordered sampling + press−50 bridge target. One ops lesson: Isaac swallows SIGINT; TERM/KILL required (per-scene stat dumps meant nothing was lost). V2.1 snapshot bank build launched: 240 entries (5 press rungs + grasp anchors, all 40 scenes) with grip-fidelity restores, overnight ~6–8 h; V2.1 training launches on completion.

Grip-fidelity verdict: the fix works — median relative-pose drift 0.0 mm across all 176 holding entries (the class that sagged 5–15 cm now measures zero). d70 fully cured (6/6), d110 4/6; grasp anchors 39/40 valid. Blemish, honestly recorded: overall 131/240 (55%) validated — the inline reset lacks v1's marginal-settle retry, so near-miss stillness cases (drift 0.0 but dz 1.5–3.6 mm; d240 all press rungs) failed that v1 would have recovered; patch + targeted rerun of ~20 demos scheduled for the Thursday pause. V2.1 training launched on the 131 valid entries + harvest states: grasp (pick_up_from) + press co-trained in one policy, rung-ORDERED sampling, press−50 bridge, all three frozen bars adjudicable.

tag: seeding root-caused: snapshots are settled states, not frames
html: Three-suspect morning, resolved by discriminating diagnostics: assisted grasp innocent (serialized snapshots restore the constraint natively); frequency flag innocent; controllers innocent (the 'lag' profile is normal — identical in the successful run). Root cause: a snapshot is the world ~90 settle-steps AFTER its demo frame — velocities zeroed, millimeters shifted — so frame-indexed demo actions can never land a 2.2 cm press from it, while the same actions PRESS (step 24) from a true playback restore. Consequences: zero RL hours wasted (snapshots are exactly what RL needs; all successes real); seeding was broken-by-design since it existed, never a scene property; parts of the d110 sag story need re-reading (its replay evidence shared the same artifact). Fixes landed: seed_from_demo now uses playback restore of the true frame; OG_PLAYBACK_REAL_FREQS=1 in launchers; replay-fidelity becomes a standing bank-validation gate. Accountability note, banked: a 30-second dynamic replay check specified at bank-day-one would have caught this immediately — static validation of states is not validation of their futures. V2.1 relaunched with working seeding (trigger lowered to 8 successless episodes).

tag: seeding round 2: replay budget + AG double-pin; stale-process day
html: Evening check found two faults. (1) The morning kill of V2.1a never landed — Isaac swallowed the signal and the old trainer ran all day beside v21b, halving throughput (278 s per 300-step episode; ~26k env steps in 7.5 h). Both processes confirmed dead this time; single-sim rule restored. (2) Seeding failed again (0 SEEDED / 5 SEED_FAILED), for two NEW reasons, both mine: the seed path re-pinned the assisted grasp after playback restore — but playback carries the grasp natively, so the second constraint lands with disjointed transforms and the snap perturbs the held radio (the successful diagnostic never re-pinned); and max_steps=80 was structurally too short for press−100 (needs >100 frames) and the grasp rung (lift + 15-step dwell). Fixes: no AG re-pin in the seed path; replay budget computed per entry (press: press_frame − frame + 60; grasp: 240). Interim signal, worth keeping: warm-scene press transferred instantly through the prior buffer (d20 s0 6/6, d40 s0 5/6) while grasp is 0/89 everywhere — precisely the rung seeding exists to ignite. V2.1c launched, warm-started from the v21b checkpoint (−−resume), fixed wrapper, full GPU.

tag: grasp seeding SOLVED: five stacked root causes, verified end-to-end
html: The evening's seed failure on d30 pulled a thread that unraveled five stacked defects, each verified by a discriminating diagnostic. (1) Off-by-one action layout: the true env action is [base 0:3, trunk 3:7, arm_left 7:14, left_grip 14, arm_right 15:22, right_grip 22] — v1's constants put the right arm at 14:21 and left grip at 21, so every right-arm RL command since v1 was misrouted (press survived only because press is left-armed). (2) Wrong arm attribution: all 40 demos grasp RIGHT-armed; the bank hardcoded left on all 40 — grasp RL was commanding the wrong arm at the wrong channels, fully explaining 0/89. (3) Open-loop replay cuts corners: this env's gains are softer than the collection rig's; the arm lags 0.4 rad mid-trajectory and skips the 14 cm grasp-approach dip entirely — replay is now closed-loop (hold each target until tracked). (4) The demos grasp magnetically: state-sweep forensics show the radio sliding 25 cm INTO the stationary hand in 8 frames — the teleop rig's assisted grasp engages from ~30 cm and pulls the object in. (5) Recordings carry no AG state (no serialized-constraint marker in any state row), so no restore could ever resurrect a grasp. Fix: at the demo's grip-close command the seed path now establishes the AG constraint anchored at the palm, reproducing the rig's pull. End-to-end verification: SD SUCCESS at step 61 — the first seeded grasp in campaign history. Banks re-patched (arm audit), constants fixed, V2.1d launched warm from the v21c checkpoint. Strategic question opened: does the EVAL env allow magnetic grasps? Either answer changes how everyone should train.

tag: eval AG question ANSWERED: no magnets at eval; the demos lie at grasp moments
html: Same-evening resolution of update #5's strategic question, from the challenge repo's own files. eval/r1pro.yaml sets grasping_mode: assisted, whose source semantics require finger contact ∧ a between-finger raycast hit ∧ 0.3 s of sustained closure — no ranged engagement exists in any code path. And the recording's embedded env config shows collection ran assisted mode too: the 30 cm magnetic pull was a teleop-layer privilege (an external _establish_grasp call on the operator's trigger), never an environment behavior. Three consequences. (1) The 200 human demos per task contain grasp actions that are physically invalid under eval physics — the recorded fingers close ~30 cm early and the object flies in; behavior cloning inherits a gesture that eval will never reward, a clean candidate explanation for VLAs stalling before contact. (2) Our RL env matches eval exactly (same robot class, same assisted machinery) — V2.1d is training precisely the grasp eval scores, and RL successes become the only physically-valid grasp supervision in our whole corpus: the strongest justification yet for the skill-as-data-factory flywheel. (3) Magnetic seed transitions are off-eval-manifold by construction — they exist to bootstrap the critic; if value overestimation at close-at-range states appears, trim seeds to their post-grasp lift segments. Confirmed alongside: physics 120 Hz / control 30 Hz.

tag: FIRST IN-TRAINING SEEDED GRASP: 67 transitions planted on d20
html: SEEDED d20 sG: 67 transitions SUCCESS — at 10:07 PM, after the per-family trigger fix, the complete seeding recipe executed inside the live training loop for the first time: playback restore to the pre-closure frame, closed-loop replay through the approach, magnetic AG at the demo's trigger moment, lift past +5 cm, 15-step hold. Sixty-seven transitions including the terminal reward=1 now sit in the RLPD buffer — the first positive grasp signal any critic in this campaign has ever received. The chain that made this possible: snapshot≠frame (Tue AM) → playback restore → no-repin + budget (Tue PM) → arm attribution + action-layout off-by-one + closed-loop replay + magnetic AG (Tue night) → per-family trigger (10 min ago). Watch item now: TD propagation — does d20's grasp rung move off 0 within ~50 policy episodes, with the policy discovering eval-legal (contact + 0.3 s closure) grasps guided by seeded value optimism.

tag: v21e window verdict: 0/58 flat -> v21f with guaranteed seed share
html: The pre-registered window closed: 58 grasp episodes after the first seed, zero conversions — though the final stretch showed the first genuine trend (last-8 distances 0.12–0.17 m, tightest of the campaign, vs 0.15–0.24 earlier): seed value was propagating, at the diluted rate the sampling analysis predicted (~2 seed tuples per 256-batch while RLPD's guaranteed half went to press splices). Grasp seeding itself went 3-for-3 in-training (d20/d30/d40, 199 planted transitions). Two more finds tonight: d40's press seeds failed because press-in-hand scenes drop the radio at restore (recordings carry no AG) — fixed by re-creating the hold at the object's CURRENT pose (coincident anchors, no snap); and holding_arm was the THIRD field infected by the left-hand default (all 176 press entries said left; every demo holds right) — banks patched from the audit, with a double-pin guard added so the fix cannot perturb the working press path. V2.1f launched (resume v21e ckpt): dedicated seed buffer at a guaranteed 25% batch share (~30× seed exposure), held-press seed fix, corrected banks. Watcher armed: conversion or 70-episode flat close.

tag: v21f flat at 0/70 despite 25% seed share -> the mirage diagnosis -> v21g annealed AG assist
html: The seed-share window also closed flat: 0/70 grasp conversions with seeds at 25% of every batch (approach floor improved to 0.10 m — campaign best — but no commits). This falsifies dilution-as-the-whole-story and confirms the deeper defect flagged when the magnetic seeds were built: the mirage. Seeds teach the critic that closing the gripper at ~25 cm yields success (with the teleop magnet, it did); the actor tries exactly that under eval physics and gets nothing; its own failures then contradict the seed data at the same states, the critic oscillates between two incompatible physics, and the actor stalls precisely at the boundary where the worlds diverge. Escalation shipped in v21g: the annealed AG-assist curriculum — the wrapper grants the rig's ranged engage when the policy commits (closes the gripper) within the current assist radius, starting at 0.30 m (exact parity with the demos and the seeds, so rollout and seed physics agree and successes flow), shrinking 5 cm per scene each time that scene's grasp rolling rate holds ≥0.5, terminating at 0 = native eval physics (contact ∧ raycast ∧ 0.3 s closure). A reverse curriculum on the CONSTRAINT rather than the start state — the same weaning the human operators never had to do. Flywheel export will gate on strict-physics episodes only. v21g resumed from the v21f checkpoint; watcher adjudicates ≥3 successes flowing or 50 flat.

tag: telemetry morning: reward desert + grip jitter found and fixed (v21h, v21i)
html: Two rapid telemetry-driven iterations after the assist curriculum went live. v21h added grasp-family shaping (one-time +0.3 on AG acquisition; potential-based lift progress paying only NEW height) after reading the reward code: the press-era terms end at finger contact, leaving a sparse desert across the entire acquire→lift→hold segment. Its new per-episode telemetry then produced the sharpest diagnosis of the campaign in eight episodes: assist_fired=True every grasp episode (the policy commits within range every time), lift progress up to 4.4 cm (0.6 cm from threshold!) — and ag=False at every episode end: the weld engages and then RELEASES, because OmniGibson drops the constraint the moment the grip command goes positive and an untrained stochastic grip channel jitters open within a few steps. Press never suffered this — its holding arm is commanded by the stationary hold action, not the policy. v21i adds the debounced grip latch: while holding, the command stays closed unless the policy deliberately releases (a[11] > 0.8 for 5 consecutive steps) — the same discrete-gripper semantics real robot stacks use. The grasp ladder is now paid and mechanically closed end-to-end: approach (shaped) → commit (assist in radius) → hold (latch) → lift (progress payments, 4.4 cm already exhibited) → success (+5 cm ∧ 15-dwell). Watcher: ≥3 flowing or 40 flat.

tag: 🎉 FIRST RL GRASP SUCCESSES — 3/3, ~50 steps each (v21j)
html: V2.1j's first three grasp episodes all SUCCEEDED — 52, 49, and 51 steps, lift 9.1–9.5 cm (nearly double threshold), assist fired inside the 0.30 m radius, hold persisting through the dwell. These are the first reinforcement-learned grasps in campaign history. The final wall was the weld lever arm: welding at engage range left 15–30 cm of constraint compliance + table drag that capped lift at 2 cm regardless of arm motion; v21j pulls the object to 10 cm from the palm before welding (exactly the rig's pull visible in the demo states: 25 cm in 8 frames, held at 0.175 m). The complete five-day chain, every link telemetry-verified: snapshot≠frame → playback restore → arm attribution → action-layout off-by-one → closed-loop replay → magnetic AG → per-family trigger → seed share → annealed assist → lift shaping → grip latch → pull-in weld. Now: successes at radius 0.30 begin the anneal (5 cm per consolidation step toward 0 = eval physics); press−5 on d20 relearns its honest reset pose with its first held-press seed under the fixed restore. Flywheel export gates on strict-physics episodes; the curriculum's job is to earn them.

tag: press prior contamination CONFIRMED and retired (v21k)
html: User-directed immediate fix. Verification first: 139/160 v1 bank entries carry holding_arm='left' and v1's reset re-pinned that arm with no guard — so all 5,906 prior-buffer press splices were collected under the spurious left weld and encode the OLD radio reset pose. At 37.5% of every batch they were actively teaching the stale button location against the honest world — the same mirage-data disease as the magnetic demos, this time in our own replay corpus. Fix: the prior buffer is retired (--prior off): batches become 75% online / 25% seeds, where the seed buffer contains only honest-world successes (both families; the held-press seed path is validated) and grows every scene visit. v21k resumed from the v21j checkpoint, preserving the 11/15 grasp competence and the anneal state machinery (d30 parked at 0.15 — the measured competence frontier). Watchers: press recovery (≥3), grasp scaling (≥12), or an 80-episode checkpoint review.

tag: V2.1l: the chain becomes the task — RLPD + reverse curriculum on grasp→press
html: User-directed pivot to the campaign's real objective: the chain as ONE task. Four pieces shipped. (1) Hold repair: press snapshots were dumped with the pre-audit left weld baked in (snapshots serialize AG), so v21f+ resets were creating a double-hold world — resets now transfer any stray weld to the audited right holder (coincident establish, then release). This supersedes the "honest world" of v21f–k; press's slow relearn is explained a second time. (2) Bridge harvest: every grasp success donates its end state (radio held, lifted) as a press start entry — stage 'H', up to 3 per scene, bypassing the press rung-gate. Press now trains on the true handoff distribution: press-from-scratch at the data level while keeping the shared network's motor competence. (3) Chain episodes: every 4th episode in grasp-consolidated scenes runs grasp→goal-switch→press with the grasp-success step stored done=0, so press value bootstraps backward through the boundary — grasp actions become valuable BECAUSE they lead to pressable states. (4) Chain seeds: the demos are full chains; the first chain per scene replays the human's grasp-through-press as one planted trajectory, goal one-hot flipping at the grasp moment. The reverse-curriculum ladder now reads: press-from-demo rungs → press-from-bridge → full chain → (later) VLA-boundary states. v21l resumed from v21j; watcher adjudicates the first complete chain.

tag: user film review: the air-grasp — pull-in moved to the finger cage + sticky rung (v21m)
html: The user watched the grasp film and called it: the gripper closes on empty air while the radio floats 10 cm off the wrist. Correct on both counts — and it exposed a curriculum discontinuity beyond cosmetics: the ranged rungs never exercise the motor program eval actually scores (align fingers AROUND the object, contact, sustained closure), which is the likely true cause of the 0.15-radius wall. Two fixes in v21m: (1) pull-in now places the object at the fingertip midpoint — a genuine held pose matching demo geometry, visually and physically a grasp from rung one; (2) a STICKY rung: once a scene's radius anneals to ≤0.10, the assist fires only on actual finger contact with the target (OmniGibson sticky-mode semantics) — the hand must reach and touch. The ladder is now ranged (bootstrap) → contact-required (sticky) → native eval AG (contact ∧ raycast ∧ 0.3 s), converging in GEOMETRY, not just distance. Export gate unchanged: only strict-physics episodes feed the flywheel. Chain/bridge machinery carries over unchanged; v21m resumed from the v21j checkpoint.

tag: 🏆 FIRST COMPLETE GRASP→PRESS CHAIN (v21o, chain attempt #4)
html: CHAIN d20 phase=2 succ=True — press phase closed in 12 steps. At 3:03 PM the campaign's actual objective executed end-to-end in one episode under one policy: approach → grasp (assisted commit, finger-cage hold) → lift → goal switch → left-arm transport to the held radio → press. Episode reward 2.74 vs 0.23/0.21/−0.91 for the three prior attempts — the fourth attempt converted after the chain seed (24-transition demo replay of grasp-through-press) and three bridge harvests entered the buffer at guaranteed share, exactly the RLPD-on-the-chain design: the chain seed supplied the transport lesson, TD propagated press value back through the done=0 boundary, and the policy composed it. One success is one success — consolidation across attempts and scenes is the next bar — but the architecture question ("can the reverse curriculum + RLPD learn the CHAIN as one task?") now has an existence proof. Film to follow at the next checkpoint.

tag: tripwire fired: 0/9 chains in v21p -> anti-drift shaping (v21q)
html: The consolidation tripwire closed at 0/9 chain attempts in v21p (1/15 lifetime since the 3:03 PM completion). Escalation applied per the staged plan: anti-drift shaping for held-object press phases — the radio's position is anchored when the press context begins (at reset for bridge-press, at the goal switch for chains), and displacement beyond a 5 cm deadzone is penalized potential-based (returning to station pays back). This targets the FILMED failure mode directly: in all three chain takes the right arm carried the radio off-station while the left hand hunted. v21q resumed from the v21p checkpoint; watcher adjudicates chains flowing (≥2) or flat (0/10). Also in v21p before the cycle: d30 joined the chain roster (grasp converting, three bridges, chain seed planted) — two scenes now run chain attempts.

tag: the drift was a stale hold command, not a policy failure (v21r)
html: Comparing anti-drift chains (v21q: negative episode returns = the penalty firing constantly) against the filmed footage forced a re-derivation, and the mechanism fell out: the non-active arm is commanded to hold_act every step, and hold_act is computed at RESET — the right arm's stationary targets are its PRE-GRASP pose. After grasp+lift, that stale command steers the holding arm back down and away, dragging the radio — the filmed "drift" was an arm faithfully tracking obsolete targets, not exploration. Bridge-press episodes were immune (their hold_act comes from the bridge state), which is why only chains showed it; the single 12-step chain success simply outraced the drift. Fix: refresh hold_act at the goal switch (trainer chain block + chain-seed flip) — two lines, mechanical, no learning required. The anti-drift shaping stays as belt-and-suspenders. v21r resumed from the v21p checkpoint; watcher: chains flowing (≥2) or flat (0/10).

With the stale-hold sabotage removed, chains stabilized into a clean profile — phase 2 reached every time, left hand transporting to ~0.46 m, budget expiring mid-approach — but 0/10 conversions. Overnight bundle in v21s: chain re-seeding every scene visit (full-horizon demos accumulate instead of once-ever), phase-2 budget 450 steps (transport + press did not fit in 300 at the current creep rate), doubled approach shaping in transport contexts (held-object press episodes), and bridge entries excluded from demo-replay seeding (both of d30's seed slots had been wasted on unseedable synthetic states). Monitor now reports only chain SUCCESSES, seeds, anneals, and crashes. The morning review reads: chain conversions, transport-distance trend, assist anneal progress, and press-rung recovery on the clean data.

tag: L2-liveness eval: the skill IGNORES its geometry input (6/6 vs 6/6)
html: First measured L2 reliance test (v21s checkpoint, d20 grasp, deterministic actor, 6 episodes per condition): 6/6 success with L2 intact, 6/6 with all 64 dims zeroed, statistically identical final distances. The skill has learned to ignore its occupancy input — the same dead-input pattern as the VLA's affordance point, obeying the same law the campaign keeps rediscovering: inputs the task does not DEMAND go unused. At assist radius 0.30 the live target vector + proprio fully determine approach; the L2 grid is redundant. Caveats: eval-time reliance ≠ training contribution (B3-proper, the trained-without-L2 arm, still pending on the A100); single scene; the designed value of L2 is precision/clutter contexts that the current rung does not exercise. Consequences for Run-3: distilling "L2-source geometry" from a skill that ignores L2 teaches the VLA nothing about using it — the conditional-PMI and object-motion objectives are now load-bearing for the map/L2 revival, and an arm where the target VECTOR is degraded (forcing geometry to carry the signal) becomes worth adding. Also: the map-token visual atlas shipped tonight shows the tokens are RICH; this eval shows richness without demand is not enough.
